summary: Recognize known Submittal dispositions under explicit Review Response, Final Response and Submittal Response labels through the existing status path.
decision_refs: The active goal requires better RFI, Submittal and Email accuracy and adaptability
Autodesk official Submittal report documentation lists Review Response and Final Response fields
Ponytail review retained the existing format scope and status mapping instead of adding spreadsheet ingestion or a custom-response engine
approval_evidence: The persistent user goal explicitly requires continued accuracy and adaptability improvements across RFI, Submittal and Email content.
known_limitations: Only existing known disposition phrases are structured; arbitrary project-specific responses remain source text for review.
Multiple explicit responses are retained as ambiguous and no final-response precedence is inferred.
Validation is synthetic and offline; no customer document, mailbox or paid provider was used.
